nodes.title: Three-dissection of $(q;q)_\infty / (q^2;q^2)_\infty^2$

nodes.summary: Let $q$ be a complex number with $|q| < 1$, and for each integer $k \ge 1$ write $E_k = (q^k; q^k)_\infty$, the infinite q-Pochhammer symbol $\prod_{n=0}^{\infty} (1 - q^{k(n+1)})$. Then
nodes.title: Eta-quotient identity in the powers $q^3$, $q^6$, $q^9$ and $q^{18}$

nodes.summary: For every natural number $m$, the number of overpartitions of $m$ equals the number of pairs $(P, S)$ in which $P$ is a finite multiset of positive integers with sum $m$ and $S$ is a finite set of natural numbers each belonging to $P$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions as pairs of a multiset and a set

nodes.summary: For every integer $n \ge 1$, the number of overpartitions of $5n$ is congruent modulo $5$ to $(-1)^n r_3(n)$, where $r_3(n)$ is the number of ordered triples $(x, y, z)$ of integers with $x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = n$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions of $5n$ modulo $5$

nodes.summary: For every integer $n \ge 1$, the number of pairs $(P, S)$, where $P$ is a finite multiset of positive integers with sum $5n$ and $S$ is a finite set of natural numbers each belonging to $P$, is congruent modulo $5$ to $(-1)^n$ times the number of ordered triples $(x, y, z)$ of integers with $x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = n$.
nodes.title: Overpartitions of $5n$ modulo $5$, explicit form

nodes.summary: For all natural numbers $\alpha$ and $n$, the number $\overline{p}(m)$ of overpartitions of $m$ satisfies $\overline{p}(3^{8\alpha+7}(24n+5)) \equiv 0 \pmod{512}$ and $\overline{p}(3^{8\alpha+7}(24n+13)) \equiv 0 \pmod{512}$.
nodes.title: Liang's congruences modulo 512 for overpartitions

nodes.summary: For every natural number $n$, the three-square representation count $r_3(n)$ equals the number of ordered triples $(x, y, z)$ of integers with $x^2 + y^2 + z^2 = n$.
nodes.title: The three-square count counts all integer solutions

can_prove.label: ready to prove
can_prove.meaning: Statement is in Lean and nothing it needs is blocked, so the proof can start.

can_state.label: ready to state
can_state.meaning: Everything its statement uses is in Lean, so the statement can be written in Lean.

conditional.label: conditionally proved
conditional.meaning: Proof compiles, but rests on an open statement without a recorded Lean proof.

fully_proved.label: fully proved
fully_proved.meaning: Proved, and every prerequisite is fully proved too.

inventory_checked.label: inventory checked
inventory_checked.meaning: Module inventory checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

inventory_pending.label: inventory pending
inventory_pending.meaning: Module inventory not yet checked in full; it records inspection, not a mathematical proof.

not_ready.label: not ready
not_ready.meaning: Needs more blueprint work before it can be attempted.

proved.label: proved
proved.meaning: Proof compiles, but something it rests on is not finished.

stated.label: statement formalized
stated.meaning: Statement is in Lean; the proof is not.
